messages:
devon: Quick thread - Sales flagged an edge case: tenant with multiple reserved pools wants to shift unused burst from pool A -> pool B automatically. They call it cross-pool carryover.
sasha: uh that's risky. could be used to game headroom across regions. we need a global tenant-level cap and explicit opt-in.
finance-bot: billing note: cross-pool moves must be transparent on invoice. each transfer needs a transfer_id and appears as two line items (revoke + grant) for reconciliation.
rebecca: ops view: transferring credits across regions complicates placement and locality. latency-sensitive tenants shouldn't get credits that force routing to distant region. propose region-bound carryover by default.
devon: proposal: three knobs: (1) pool_local_only (bool), (2) tenant_global_cap_pct, (3) per-pool allow_inbound_transfers (enum: disabled/opt-in/auto).
```
carryover_settings:
  pool_local_only: true
  tenant_global_cap_pct: 20
  inbound_transfer_policy: opt_in
```
sasha: policy idea: when inbound_transfer_policy = opt_in, both source and destination pool owners must accept the transfer in Console or via API. avoids stealth transfers.
ops-oncall: add safety: transfers emit TRANSFER_REQUEST and TRANSFER_COMPLETE telemetry; if transfers > baseline*X in 1h, auto-block and page ops. Also require idempotent transfer_id.
finance-bot: also require that transfers respect consumption order: transferred credits consume before destination's reserved quota but after destination's local carryover (if any). clear rule prevents double-dipping.
rebecca: product decision: can we support automatic rebalancing for tenant-level fairness? e.g., if tenant has 3 pools, we keep carryover balanced proportionally unless explicit transfer requested. that reduces manual ops.
devon: sounds good. let's add auto-rebalance option on tenant level: off | proportional | manual. default=proportional for enterprise.
sasha: roadmap: spike to model abuse scenarios and billing flows (1wk), then API + minimal Console (2wk). canary with 2 customers. staffing: 2 backend, 1 billing, 1 ops.
ops-oncall: canary guardrails: disallow cross-region transfers for canary, enable audit-only mode first (no actual token movement).
rebecca: launch criteria draft: 1) tenant-level cap enforcement; 2) transfer audit trail exported; 3) invoice lines for transfers; 4) opt-in flows in Console; 5) guardrails for cross-region.
product-bot: Created tickets: #PL-4215 (spike: cross-pool transfer abuse model), #BILL-2355 (transfer invoice lines), #FE-812 (Console transfer modal), #OPS-1477 (canary runbook).
devon: action items: @sasha write abuse scenarios, @finance-bot draft invoice example, @ops-oncall prepare audit-only runbook. I'll update the roadmap doc with timeline.
sasha: will do. :+1:
